accessibility.evidence: Chrome/Edge tests checked keyboard focus and Enter on login, labelled heading/navigation/auth links, reduced-motion nonsticky static anatomy, immediate anchor behavior and readable server output without JavaScript. SVG has descriptive accessible names. Phone annotations use a readable component key. This is focused coverage, not screen-reader certification.

responsive.evidence: Rendered hero/anatomy captures at all four target dimensions; no main/root horizontal overflow. Browser checks also exercise 768px width. Readable mobile CTA wrapping and persistent header entry inspected.

loading.reason: Public story has no required asynchronous data; all copy, links and illustration server-render without waiting for session restoration.

empty.reason: Public editorial surface does not load user collections or search results.

error.evidence: Mocked refresh network failure with a stale session hint does not replace public story or hide login. Existing protected-route return-to still works.

partial.evidence: JavaScript-disabled browser retains full copy, illustration and real navigation. Reduced motion removes sticky choreography while retaining all narrative and static separated layers.

success.evidence: Final production Chrome 16/16, Edge subset 4/4; login/register navigation and scroll open/reassemble/reverse checks pass.

permission.evidence: Anonymous access to / is allowed; /new/template?landing-check=1 redirects to existing login with encoded return-to. No backend authorization code changed.

Phone sticky anatomy and narrative; readable HTML clients/routing/compute/data key replaces tiny SVG callouts.
Narrow phone heading and CTA wrap naturally; login remains visible and no horizontal overflow.
